description_en: Unbinds a mobile phone or email from a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 为RAM用户解绑安全手机或安全邮箱
kebab_example: aliyun ims unbind-verification --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --verify-type sms --mobile-phone 86-13900001234 --email username@example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnbindVerification

parameters.description_en: The logon name of the RAM user.
parameters.help_en: The logon name of the RAM user
parameters.name: user_principal_name

parameters.description_en:
The multi-factor authentication (MFA) method. Valid values:

- sms: mobile phone.

- email: email.
parameters.description_zh:
多因素认证手段。取值：

- sms：安全手机。
- email：安全邮箱。
